name: How can I make a small guest bathroom feel larger?

mainEntity.name: How can I make a small guest bathroom feel larger?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small guest bathroom feel larger, consider using light-colored paint and tiles, which reflect light and create an open feel. Incorporate a wall-mounted or pedestal sink instead of a bulky vanity to free up floor space. Large mirrors can visually expand the room, and strategic lighting, such as recessed fixtures, can eliminate shadows. Opt for a glass shower enclosure over a curtain to maintain an unobstructed view and a sense of continuity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use light colors, wall-mounted sinks, large mirrors, recessed lighting, and glass shower enclosures to make a small guest bathroom feel larger.
